dct_description_sm: Opgenomen door den Hydrographischen Dienst in 1928 en '29 ; Ministerie van Defensie. Afdeeling Hydrographie.
Depths shown by soundings; relief by hachures and spot heights.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, buildings, ports.
Chart 1. Watoebela-Eilanden : 1:200,000 -- Chart 2. Banda-Eilanden : 1:100,000 [Inset chart: Reede Naira : 1:25,000].
